validation.reviewMethod: Read every active lower-primary template stem, params, answer, constraints and diagram mapping alongside pedagogical dispatch. Readiness numerical/shape results independently checked against fixed diagram data. Runtime generation and browser QA remain parent integration work.

scopeChecks: 1N4-1 models both non-carry and carry addition.
2N2-2 carries ones to tens only, matching active template constraint.
2N5-1 models ones borrowing without unsupported crossing-zero subtraction.
3N3-1 explicitly models remainder and checks remainder<divisor.
Compound-unit question families model multiply then add.
3D1 diagrams and worked values use scale1 to match current active templates.
3N5.3 uses original a,b constrained a<b; no undefined-variable maths defect confirmed.

readinessRevision.answerLeakage: Removed solved expressions, result captions, classification names and answer-bearing alt text; retained numeric givens/axis ticks/denominations.
readinessRevision.extraFractionComparison: 3N5-2 comparisonDiagram shows 1/3 vs1/5 on equal whole bars.

checks.nonLiveTasks: Exact numbers and pointing/grouping/measurement actions authored per chapter.

crossReview.scope: Focused read-only review of upper quantity/geometry/division explanations; two authorized pack corrections applied.

corrections.change: Explicit separate sufficiently large measuring vessel for displacement; label both before/after values in millilitres. The 12mL capacity example is no longer implied to hold100mL.
Six equal cells: top row marks1/2, dashed left column marks1/3, orange overlap marks1/6; model meanings are visually distinguishable.

validation.regionCheck: Top row contains3 of6 cells; left column2 of6; intersection1 of6.
validation.renderingLimit: XML and geometry semantics checked; live browser QA remains parent integration work.

crossReview.additionalFinding: course_pedagogy.figure numerical5N5.R3 branch should guard finite a,b,c,e, because library5N5.WHY.C1 has no params; current school plans only select numerical templates.

examples.2N3: Count one group, not all groups.
examples.3D1: Read the adjacent axis ticks, not a guessed scale.

readinessAltReview.change: Restore precise mathematical givens, layout, labels and marks in accessible alt text; omit computed totals, solved expressions and classification results. Count tasks use individual positions/groups rather than a summed total.
